Elena — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front:

- We support both seat-based and consumption-based billing on Redwood, but AWS Marketplace metering requires a usage dimension mapped to your account (i.e., a metering dimension that we push from our fulfillment connector). That’s standard but needs a quick mapping exercise.

- Typical lift: discovery + mapping (1 week), implementation + test (2 weeks), AWS vetting + listing update (1–2 weeks). We can expedite.

Action plan I propose:
1) Quick discovery call tomorrow to confirm the usage metric you want reported (seats vs tokens vs API calls).
2) We will send our pricing matrix and a draft amendment that procurement can attach to the PO.
3) Once metrics are agreed, we’ll enable a staging metering dimension and walk procurement through a sample invoice.

I’ve attached the pricing matrix and a short implementation checklist. Looping in Monica (sales ops) and Marcus (billing) to own the procurement and invoice examples.

Next steps: are you available 11am PT tomorrow for a 30m call?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick technical summary from AWS side to reduce back-and-forth:

1) Metering dimension: For consumption billing, create a single usage dimension (e.g., "api_units") we will associate with the SaaS listing. Redwood needs to call the Metering Service API with customer entitlement identifiers.

2) Fulfillment paths: There are two common flows — "Redwood as Fulfillment Provider" (preferred for fewer handoffs) or "Seller-managed fulfillment" where Acme acts as the seller. If Redwood will host and meter on behalf of Acme, we need a standard seller agreement and onboarding form filled.

3) Sample invoice: AWS requires a consumption CSV for reconciliation with the marketplace. We can accept a sample PDF for procurement review; the actual settlement runs via AWS billing.

I’m attaching the MPX fulfillment spec that outlines the APIs, required fields, and testing checklist. Please confirm who will be the listed seller and we’ll provide the onboarding packet.

Regards,
Theo Mallory
AWS Marketplace Partner Help
[Attachment: aws_mpx_fulfillment_specs.pdf (pdf)]
